gold: Dropped Head Syndrome (DHS) - Isolated Neck Extensor Myopathy (INEM)
e7_s4_rationale: The patient's pronounced flexion of the head and neck, particularly noticeable in the standing position, along with the absence of neurological deficits or dysphagia, aligns with the characteristics of camptocormia, a condition often presenting with isolated neck flexion deformity in the elderly.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Cervical spondylotic myelopathy
e7_s4_rejected.why: Presence of neurological deficits is common, which is not observed in this patient.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Ankylosing spondylitis
e7_s4_rejected.why: Typically presents with a broader range of symptoms including back pain and systemic symptoms, not isolated to neck flexion.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Diffuse idiopathic skeletal hyperostosis
e7_s4_rejected.why: Involves more widespread spinal and extraspinal manifestations, not limited to the cervical spine flexion deformity.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Dropped head syndrome
e7_s4_rejected.why: Often associated with neuromuscular diseases or other systemic conditions, which are not noted in this patient.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Ankylosing spondylitis
e7_s4_rejected.why: Involves significant systemic and spinal symptoms beyond isolated cervical flexion deformity.
